content:
people-ops-bot: Announcement: Samira Khan will serve as Interim Head of Model Onboarding for the next 12 weeks while Rajat is on parental leave. Summary and action items below.

Clara Ruiz: Quick update  Rajat Verma is going on parental leave starting next Monday. Samira Khan will cover as Interim Head of Model Onboarding through mid-June. Please congratulate Rajat and support Samira.

Samira Khan: Thanks all  happy to cover. My immediate focus: handoff of active model onboarding tickets, preserving rollout schedules, and owning the weekly model-readiness sync.

Diego Morales: Appreciate the heads-up. Operational asks: (1) can Samira get access to the onboarding trackers and deploy keys this week? (2) let's schedule a 1:1 handoff tomorrow with Rajat for any in-flight rollouts.

Rajat Verma: Thanks everyone  will post a handoff doc tonight with ticket list and owner matrix. All critical SLO rollouts are green; a couple of experiments are in staging. Samira, I'll be available for async Qs.

Priya Natarajan: People Ops note: we'll post the temporary reporting line update and a parental leave announcement on the org page. Also opening a short-term IC backfill req for a Model Onboarding Engineer (6-8 week contract). Internal candidates encouraged.

Samira Khan: Diego  please add me to the onboarding trackers and grant read/write to deploy-repo. I'll run the model-readiness sync this Friday.

Diego Morales: Done  Samira added to trackers and repo. Also scheduled the 30-min handoff with Rajat for tomorrow 9:30am PT.

people-ops-bot: Calendar: "Model Onboarding handoff (Rajat -> Samira)" tomorrow 9:30 AM PT.

Clara Ruiz: Two policy notes: (A) for interim covers longer than 8 weeks, please create a short role guide (1 pager) that covers decision rights; (B) any outward-facing comms about customer timelines must be routed through Clara or Priya.

Samira Khan: Understood on both. I'll publish the 1-pager by EOD Wednesday and coordinate customer comms with Priya.

Priya Natarajan: I'll draft the external-facing blurb in case Sales needs to update customers about owner change. Also posting the internal FAQ and the short-term contractor req by noon.

Rajat Verma: Thanks for the smooth transition everyone. Samira  leaving a pinned checklist in the handoff doc with priorities and a sticky note about the canary rollback script.

Clara Ruiz: Action items recap: Rajat posts handoff doc (tonight); Samira added to trackers and runs first sync Friday; Priya posts contract req and internal FAQ; Diego scheduled handoff meeting. Welcome to Samira in the interim role. :clap:
